description: This picture was taken specifically to announce my candidacy. I haven’t taken a professional photo nor worn a suit in years. Yet, as I think about it, this photo has such significance to me embarking on this new endeavor. I’ll admit, I was hesitant to run for public office, although I was encouraged by others. […]
